mini.label: 24-cup mini muffin pan
mini.geometry: 24 identical round wells in a precise 4-by-6 grid, each well about 1 3/4 inches across the top, tapering to about 1 1/4 inches at the base, about 7/8 inch deep, holding about 2 tablespoons; the whole pan is about 15 by 10 inches

standard.label: 12-cup standard muffin pan
standard.geometry: 12 identical round wells in a precise 3-by-4 grid, each well about 2 3/4 inches across the top, tapering to about 2 inches at the base, about 1 3/8 inches deep, holding about 1/2 cup; the whole pan is about 14 by 10.5 inches with a flat frame around the wells

jumbo.label: 6-cup jumbo muffin pan
jumbo.geometry: 6 identical round wells in a precise 2-by-3 grid, each well about 3 1/2 inches across the top, tapering to about 2 1/2 inches at the base, about 1 3/4 inches deep, holding about 1 cup; the whole pan is about 14 by 10 inches

muffin_top.label: 6-cup muffin top pan (specialty)
muffin_top.geometry: 6 identical wide, shallow round wells in a 2-by-3 grid, each about 4 inches across and only about 1/2 inch deep, like shallow saucers pressed into a flat sheet

popover.label: 6-cup popover pan (specialty)
popover.geometry: 6 identical deep, narrow, steep-sided cups about 2 3/4 inches across and about 2 1/2 inches deep, each a separate cup held in a 2-by-3 arrangement by a welded wire frame with open space between the cups

light_aluminized_steel.description: light silver-gold aluminized steel with a faintly corrugated, fluted surface between the wells, satin finish, crisp rolled rim along the outer edge

dark_nonstick.description: matte charcoal-black nonstick-coated carbon steel, smooth and uniform, slightly raised flat rim, faint wear on the rim from use

commercial_aluminum.description: heavy-gauge natural commercial bakery aluminum, dull satin silver with a mottled, darkened patina from years of use, wide flat flanges at each end, thick wired rim

gold_nonstick.description: champagne-gold nonstick-coated steel with a soft metallic sheen, smooth wells, neat rolled rim

stainless_steel.description: bright brushed stainless steel with soft reflections in the wells, clean rolled rim

cast_iron_gem_pan.description: seasoned black cast iron with a slightly pebbled, glossy-oiled surface, the round cups cast as one heavy piece and joined by thick cast bars with open gaps between the cups, a short cast handle at each end, in the style of an antique gem pan

vintage_starburst_tin.description: vintage tinned steel, dull silver with spotted age patina and a few darkened bake marks, each well pressed with a swirling starburst of fluted ridges, thin rolled edge, 1940s kitchenware

stoneware.description: unglazed sand-colored stoneware, thick matte walls and rounded rim, darkened seasoning blush inside the wells from use, heavy and solid

silicone.description: flexible matte silicone in a muted sage green, soft rounded rim, sitting on a plain metal baking sheet for support

pan_clause_template: THE PAN - wherever any part of the pan appears, it is this exact real pan: a {size_label} made of {material}. It has {geometry}. It is a real, rigid, manufactured baking pan: perfectly regular grid, every well identical, straight rows, no extra or missing wells, no mesh, no wire racks, no grates, no paper liners.
